name: librsvg
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family: librsvg Rust SVG engine through C API
family_note: The same librsvg source package and engine serve C and C++ call sites; this is one package path per ecosystem, not two independent parsers.

name: libvips
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family_note: Installed libvips core directly links librsvg 2.63.4. libvips is a distinct package input API but shares SVG syntax interpretation with the librsvg row.

name: imagemagick
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family: ImageMagick internal MSVG renderer with libxml2
family_note: The adapter forces ImageMagick's documented MSVG format, selecting its internal SVG renderer. The pinned SVG coder module links system libxml2; this path does not use librsvg or the external Inkscape delegate.

name: graphicsmagick
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family_note: The pinned GraphicsMagick SVG coder links system libxml2 and translates SVG to MVG. It is a separate package and SVG implementation; system libxml2 is a shared XML dependency.

name: resvg
input_api: resvg_parse_tree_from_file(local filename, options, &tree); resvg_get_image_size; resvg_render to RGBA pixmap
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family: resvg/usvg Rust SVG parser and tiny-skia renderer through C API
family_note: The C and C++ adapters use the same tagged resvg-capi source library. This is a distinct engine from librsvg, ImageMagick MSVG, and GraphicsMagick SVG-to-MVG; the two ecosystem paths are not independent from one another.

name: plutosvg
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family: PlutoSVG document parser with PlutoVG rasterizer
family_note: PlutoSVG has a C document parser used from C and C++; both ecosystem paths share that engine. LunaSVG shares the PlutoVG rasterizer but has separate SVG document parsing code.

name: libsvgtiny
input_api: svgtiny_parse(local SVG file bytes, size, URL, viewport); diagram width, height, shape count and fill colors
scope: parsed SVG dimensions, two shapes, and red/green fill colors
family: NetSurf libsvgtiny SVG Tiny parser over libdom
family_note: The same C source library serves C and C++ call sites. libsvgtiny uses the NetSurf libdom XML parser and returns parsed shapes; it does not rasterize.

name: libsvg
input_api: svg_create; svg_parse(local filename); svg_get_size parsed SVG width and height
family_note: libsvg parses SVG without drawing. Its README says it was based on old librsvg code; the installed library is separate from current librsvg. libsvg-cairo uses this same underlying parser.

name: libsvg-cairo
input_api: svg_cairo_create; svg_cairo_parse(local filename); svg_cairo_get_size; svg_cairo_render to Cairo image surface
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green rectangle pixels
family: libsvg-cairo adapter over libsvg parser and Cairo renderer
family_note: A distinct package input API, but SVG syntax parsing is delegated to the separately counted libsvg 0.1.4 package. Cairo supplies rasterization.

name: thorvg
family: ThorVG SVG loader and native vector engine
family_note: ThorVG C binding and native C++ API are distinct ecosystem call paths over the same ThorVG SVG loader; they do not represent independent syntax engines.

name: sdl3_image
input_api: SDL_IOFromFile(local filename); IMG_LoadSVG_IO(stream); SDL_ConvertSurface to RGBA32
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green RGBA pixels
family: SDL3_image SVG loader with embedded NanoSVG parser/rasterizer
family_note: The pinned IMG_svg.c includes embedded NanoSVG and nanosvgrast code; SDL3_image is a distinct package input API. Its C function is called from C and C++ adapters over one SVG engine.

name: gdk-pixbuf
scope: parsed SVG dimensions and rendered red/green RGBA pixels
family: GdkPixbuf loader API with librsvg SVG plugin
family_note: The installed GdkPixbuf SVG loader module comes from librsvg 2.63.4, which is separately counted. This is a distinct package input API over the same librsvg SVG syntax engine.

name: nanosvg
input_api: nsvgParseFromFile(local SVG filename, "px", 96.0f); inspect NSVGimage shape/path lists
scope: SVG root dimensions and two parsed rectangle shapes with paths
family_note: SDL3_image embeds NanoSVG; this direct C API is a distinct package path over the same parser family. Upstream has no tagged release; vcpkg publishes version-date 2023-12-29 pinned to the exact upstream commit.

name: mupdf
scope: SVG dimensions and two rendered RGB pixels
family: MuPDF native SVG document parser and renderer
family_note: Same MuPDF package also has a separate PDF cell path; this SVG path uses the native source/svg parser.
